categories.main_business_segments: EVE Energy Co., Ltd. primarily operates in three main business segments: consumer batteries (including lithium primary batteries, small lithium-ion batteries, and cylindrical batteries), power batteries (for new energy vehicles and battery systems), and energy storage batteries. These segments cover a wide range of applications such as smart meters, medical devices, 3C electronics, electric tools, electric two-wheelers, clean appliances, data center backup power, and robotics. The company also has a strategic global cooperation business model (CLS) that supports its international expansion and technology licensing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs diverse lithium battery technologies including lithium-thionyl chloride batteries, lithium manganese dioxide batteries, lithium-ion batteries with ternary and lithium iron phosphate chemistries, and advanced battery systems integrating BMS and modules. It focuses on innovations such as gel semi-solid batteries for safety, solid-state batteries, lithium metal secondary batteries, and sodium-ion batteries. Manufacturing emphasizes digital twin technology, lean production, and global manufacturing capabilities with large-scale factories in China, Malaysia, and Europe.
categories.primary_customers_markets: EVE Energy serves a broad customer base across consumer electronics, automotive (new energy vehicles including passenger and commercial vehicles), industrial applications, and energy storage sectors. Key markets include smart wearable devices, medical equipment, electric tools, electric two-wheelers, clean appliances, data centers, robotics, and renewable energy storage. The company collaborates with leading global customers in these sectors and is expanding into emerging markets such as eVTOL aircraft and unmanned aerial vehicles.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with manufacturing and sales presence in China, Southeast Asia (notably Malaysia), Europe (Hungary and Germany), North America (USA), and other regions. It has established production bases near major automotive hubs, such as the BMW plant in Debrecen, Hungary, and is expanding its overseas capacity to enhance local delivery and mitigate trade risks. Its sales cover domestic Chinese markets and international markets, with overseas sales accounting for about 24% of total revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: EVE Energy operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the lithium battery supply chain, focusing on battery cell production, module and system integration, and battery solutions. The company also actively integrates upstream resources by investing in nickel-cobalt-lithium raw material projects and battery material production, aiming to build a resilient and vertically integrated supply chain from raw materials to battery recycling and remanufacturing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation with a large international R&D team and multiple research institutes. Key R&D directions include solid-state batteries, lithium metal secondary batteries, sodium-ion batteries, high-performance power batteries, and energy storage systems with intelligent management. It emphasizes digital transformation in manufacturing and supply chain, green and sustainable development with carbon neutrality goals by 2030 (operations) and 2040 (value chain), and expanding global cooperation through its CLS model.
categories.revenue_model: EVE Energy generates revenue primarily through direct sales of lithium battery products across its consumer, power, and energy storage segments. The company also earns income from technology licensing, cooperative R&D, and service support under its CLS global cooperation business model. Revenue is derived from product sales to a diversified customer base in various industries and geographic regions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: EVE Energy is a leading global lithium battery manufacturer with strong market positions in consumer batteries, power batteries for new energy vehicles, and energy storage batteries. It ranks second in the domestic commercial vehicle battery market and is among the top global suppliers in energy storage cells. The company competes with other major lithium battery producers by leveraging technological innovation, scale, and global manufacturing footprint.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, EVE Energy reported total revenue of approximately RMB 48.6 billion, with a slight year-on-year decrease of 0.35%. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB 4.08 billion, showing a modest increase. The company’s energy storage segment grew significantly by nearly 92%, while power battery revenue declined by 20%. Total assets exceeded RMB 100 billion, reflecting a 6.93% increase. The company maintains a strong R&D investment ratio of over 6% of revenue and continues to expand production capacity globally.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: EVE Energy emphasizes its comprehensive lithium battery technology portfolio and full-scene application solutions, supporting digitalization and sustainable development. Its products are distinguished by high reliability, safety, long life, and advanced performance tailored for diverse applications from consumer electronics to electric vehicles and large-scale energy storage. The company’s integrated global manufacturing and supply chain capabilities, combined with its CLS cooperation model, provide customers with reliable, innovative, and localized battery solutions that accelerate energy transformation and connectivity.
